Im Tropen-Aquarium müssen Dr. Guido Westhoff und sein Kollege die Giftschlangen umquartieren, damit die Schlosser Reparaturen vornehmen können und dabei nicht gebissen werden.

Im Elefantenhaus bekommt die kleine Rani ein schmuckes Lederhalsband. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Die Nordreportage
programme.desc:
Nachwuchs im Schweinestall

Auf Hof Sonnenschein im niedersächsischen Aurich sind gerade 18 Sauen hochtragend. Hermann Poppen sieht täglich mehrfach nach ihnen, um sich davon zu überzeugen, dass es ihnen gut geht. An diesem Tag haben bereits vier Sauen Nachwuchs bekommen. Die Geburt bewältigen sie meistens komplett allein. Aber nicht immer läuft alles ideal, und dann muss Hermann eingreifen.

Eine Sau liegt zum Beispiel auf dem Bauch, sodass die Ferkel nicht an das Gesäuge mit der Milch herankommen. Eine andere Sau hat sich auf ihr frisch geborenes Ferkel gelegt.

In Schleswig-Holstein ist Urte Schulz-Möllgaard im Stress. Ihr Mann Jörg fällt zurzeit wegen einer Erkrankung mit Gürtelrose aus. Und von ihrer Auszubildenden Lara haben sie sich einvernehmlich getrennt. Dementsprechend lastet deutlich mehr Hofarbeit auf Urtes Schultern. Außerdem muss sie die Kinder versorgen und ihrem neuen Nebenjob nachgehen. Den hat sie zusätzlich zu ihrem Vollzeitjob auf dem Hof übernommen, weil der momentan niedrige Milchpreis ihre Kosten nicht deckt. Aber Urte lässt sich nicht unterkriegen und blickt trotz allem positiv nach vorne.

Auf dem Sophienhof beginnt der Tag holprig. Eigentlich will Klauenpfleger Mirko Eichmann mit seiner Arbeit beginnen, aber dafür braucht er Strom. Und das Dieselaggregat läuft nicht rund. Dann entwischt – nach einem Missverständnis – eine Kuh. Außerdem läuft parallel die Kartoffelernte. Das bedeutet, es sind eigentlich zu wenig Leute für diese Aktion. Und Hofchef Karsten Dudziak hat auch keine Zeit. Azubi Helene Blohm ist auf jeden Fall ein bisschen genervt.

Im Harzer Herrhausen geht die Weinlese weiter. Nach den roten Cabaret-Noir-Trauben sind jetzt die weißen Muscaris-Trauben reif. Zahlreiche Helfer packen wieder mit an und unterstützen das junge Team vom Thudts Hof. Für Azubi Max Barchewitz ist es die erste Weinlese. Inzwischen hat er eine höhere Wertschätzung für Wein bekommen, denn er hat selbst erfahren, wie viel Arbeit dahintersteckt. An diesem Tag sitzt allen die Zeit im Nacken, denn für den Nachmittag ist im Harzer Vorland Regen angesagt. Und der könnte die Ernte verderben. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: DAS! Rote Sofa
programme.desc:
Gast DAS! Rote Sofa: Clara Lösel, Poetry-Künstlerin und Schriftstellerin

Nachdem sie Deutsch und Spanisch studiert hatte, um am Gymnasium zu unterrichten, entschied sich Clara Lösel doch anders.

Bekannt wurde sie durch emotionale und gesellschaftskritische Gedichte auf Social Media. Ihre nahbare Poesie handelt von mentaler Gesundheit, Politik, dem Erwachsenwerden und baut Brücken zwischen den Generationen. Und so wuchs ihr Publikum schnell von Klassengröße in die Hunderttausende.

Allein Lösels Gedicht „Faschistendöner“, mit dem sie sich gegen Rechtspopulismus wandte, erreichte millionenfache Abrufe.

Vor Kurzem ist ihr Buch „Ich dachte, sowas fühl nur ich“ erschienen, in dem sie 101 Texte versammelt, die lebensverändernd wirken sollen. Das ist u. a. ein Thema, über das sie auf dem Roten Sofa spricht. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: die nordstory: Zwischen Watt und Wolken
programme.desc:
Jahrelang hat er das nördlichste Bundesland aus der Vogelperspektive gesehen. Dann erblindet er. Trotzdem macht der Sylter Fluglehrer weiter, verlässt sich auf sein Gehör, Gespür, seine Erfahrung. 

Wenige Zentimeter von einer Stromleitung entfernt befestigt ein junger Monteur Vogelschutzmarker, sitzt dabei auf einer Art Balkon außen am Hubschrauber. Eine falsche Bewegung könnte katastrophal enden.

Über Menschen zwischen Adrenalinkick und Freiheitsgefühl, mit beeindruckenden Luftaufnahmen.

programme.title: Mit Mut, Mörtel und Millionen Tipps
programme.desc:
Schon acht Gutshäuser haben sie mit ihrer bewährten Ruckizucki-Methode zumindest bewohnbar gemacht: Knut Splett-Henning und seine dänische Ehefrau Christina von Ahlefeldt-Laurvig.

Jetzt haben sie sich das Schloss Lüssow bei Anklam vorgenommen. Ein riesiger Kasten: 3000 Quadratmeter, um die 100 Fenster.

Scheibchenweise wollen sie es nutzbar machen und dabei die jetzigen Bewohner nicht vertreiben. Turmfalke, Eule und Fledermaus haben das Schloss in den mehr als 40 Jahren des Leerstandes zu ihrem Zuhause gemacht.

Die neuen Besitzer, sie träumen von friedlicher Koexistenz von Mensch und Tier. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: NDR Talk Show
programme.desc:
Zu ihrem 80. Geburtstag am 2.8. machte sich die Hamburgerin Inga Rumpf selbst ein großes Geschenk – einen Auftritt in der ausverkauften Elbphilharmonie am 13.9.! Ihre musikalische Laufbahn begann 1965 bei der Folk-Rock-Gruppe City Preachers. Mit den Bands Frumpy und Atlantis schrieb sie in den 1970er-Jahren Musikgeschichte und stand später mit internationalen Größen wie B. B. King und Aerosmith auf der Bühne. Selbst Tina Turner nahm ihren Song „I Wrote A Letter“ auf. Auf ein Genre festlegen ließ sich Inga Rumpf nicht. Darüber und über eine Karriere als Rock-Pionierin spricht sie in der Sendung. 

Des Weiteren sind Diana Amft und Florian David Fitz, die mit der Erfolgsserie „Doctor’s Diary“ zwischen 2008 und 2011 zu Publikumslieblingen wurden, zu Gast. Als Gretchen Haase und Dr. Marc Meier begeisterten sie Millionen Zuschauende. Rund 15 Jahre später stehen die beiden Schauspieler nun wieder gemeinsam vor der Kamera, diesmal für die Kinokomödie „Der perfekte Urlaub“, die an den Kinohit „Das perfekte Geheimnis“ anknüpft. 

Und u. a. zu Gast: Christine Westermann.

programme.title: PythagoraSwitch
programme.desc: This Japanese show, presented by Masahiko Satō and Masumi Uchino, aims to enhance and develop the way that children think. The show is split into segments (called 'corners') and each corner is separated by a Pythagorean Device. The main corner is focused on a puppet show where Grandpa Encyclopedia explains the ways of the world to young penguins Pita and Gora. Other corners include the Algorithm Exercise which involves participating in movement routines, usually with special guests taking part; Otou-san Switch in which the sounds of Japanese letters are the basis for games between a father and his child; and Botejin where a dice-shaped potato covered in words moves over tiles on the ground.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Die ältere und sehr vermögende Dame Esther Scully wird erschlagen in ihrem Haus aufgefunden. Ihr Ehemann Harold Scully steht als Erbe sofort unter Verdacht.

Matlock kennt Harold und ist nicht besonders gut auf ihn zu sprechen. Daher ist der Anwalt auch alles andere als begeistert, als Harold ihn bittet, seine Verteidigung zu übernehmen.

Zunächst scheint Harolds Lage aussichtslos. Dann treten Harolds Zwillingsnichten Julia und Emily auf den Plan. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Joe Peters ist Polizist und schon seit vielen Jahren dem Hehler Harry Landis auf der Spur.

Wenig später wird Landis erschossen aufgefunden, und der Verdacht fällt sofort auf Peters, zumal auch noch dessen Dienstwaffe benutzt wurde.

Peters bittet in seiner Verzweiflung Matlock um Hilfe. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Rock-Sängerin Angel wird beschuldigt, ihren Manager nach einem Streit mit einer Schere erstochen zu haben. Die Tat soll nachts verübt worden sein.

Matlocks Tochter Charlene ist sofort Feuer und Flamme, da endlich ein echter Superstar ihre Kanzlei betritt.

Da sich Angel nicht an die Tatnacht erinnern kann und plötzlich auch noch die Schere in ihrem Hotelzimmer gefunden wird, steht Matlock mit dem Rücken zur Wand. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Matlocks ehemaligem Jura-Professor Tate wird vorgeworfen, in der Nacht unter Alkoholeinfluss Auto gefahren zu sein und dabei einen Mann überfahren zu haben. Zudem soll Tate großen Sachschaden angerichtet und einen Hund verletzt haben.

Der Professor kann sich jedoch beim besten Willen an nichts erinnern und hofft nun auf die Unschuldsvermutung. Allerdings sprechen alle Beweise gegen ihn.

Kann Matlock seinem ehemaligen Professor helfen? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
Rollins, der Direktor einer Wohnungsbaugesellschaft, wurde brutal ermordet.

Dieser Fall ruft den Anwalt Benjamin L. Matlock auf den Plan. Klar ist: Rollins war nicht besonders beliebt. Denn immerhin wollte er ein Haus abreißen und sämtliche Mieter auf die Straße setzen lassen.

Noch am Tag vor seinem Tod zeigte sich Rollins uneinsichtig und geriet mit einem Mieter des Hauses, Tom McCabe, aneinander. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc:
In der Sendung von TV-Köchin Victoria Edwards, die auch eine Kochschule besitzt, bricht ihr Ex-Mann Michael, Autor eines Bestseller-Kochbuchs und Gast in der Sendung, nach dem Probieren plötzlich tot zusammen. Er wurde offenbar vergiftet.

Als Täterin kommt niemand anderes in Frage als Victoria selbst. Immerhin hat sie das Essen gekocht und hatte ihm stets vorgeworfen, sämtliche Ideen für sein Buch von ihr geklaut zu haben.

Matlock muss helfen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:

Eddie hat zwar überhaupt keine Lust, in derartige Angelegenheiten hineingezogen zu werden, aber dann siegt sein Mitleid mit Steve.

Eddie stellt den Schläger zur Rede – und vertreibt ihn dann mit einem gezielten Schlag.

Als die Geschichte ans Licht kommt, ist Carl ganz begeistert, dass der berühmte „Winslow-Schlag“ immer noch wirkt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Als in Eddies Klasse die Wahl zum Klassensprecher bevorsteht, redet ihm seine Schwester Laura ein, dass er genau der richtige Mann für diese Aufgabe sei, und trainiert Eddie für den Wahlkampf – nach dem Vorbild echter Politiker.

Aber es hilft alles nichts: Eddies Konkurrentin Margie hat trotzdem immer die besseren Antworten parat.

Schließlich muss Eddie zugeben, dass er nur kandidiert hat, um leichter an Mädchen heranzukommen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc:
Deacon und Kelly wollen für ein paar Tage verreisen. Doug und Carrie erklären sich bereit, auf Major aufzupassen.

Aber nachdem Doug Major eine furchtbar gruselige Geschichte erzählt, hat der Junge so viel Angst, dass er nicht mehr zu seinem Patenonkel möchte. Carrie ist froh darüber, aber Doug versucht mit allen Mitteln, das Herz des Jungen zurückzugewinnen.

Er macht jedoch alles nur noch schlimmer. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc:
Carrie und Doug sind als einzige Nachbarn nicht zum Blockfest eingeladen.

Carrie stört das nicht, aber Doug möchte, dass ihn alle mögen. Also geht er zum Fest und lässt sich dort einen herrenlosen Hund andrehen, um zu beweisen, dass er ein guter Kerl ist.

Carrie ist überhaupt nicht begeistert und besteht darauf, dass Doug sich ganz alleine um den Hund kümmert. Doch auch Doug bereut die Sache mit dem Köter schnell. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc:
Radar und Hawkeye sammeln Captain BJ Hunnicutt, den Ersatz für Trapper, am Flughafen ein.

Damit sich der neue Mann möglichst schnell an das ungewohnte Lagerleben in Korea gewöhnt, wollen die beiden ihren neuen Kollegen erst einmal mit in Rosies Bar nehmen.

Doch auf dem Weg dorthin geraten die drei unter Beschuss, und eine Weile sieht es so aus, als müssten sie ihre Willkommenstour vorzeitig abbrechen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc:

Beleidigt zieht er sich zu Hot Lips zurück. Hawkeye und B. J. sind unterdessen neugierig, was für ein Mensch der neue Chef ist, und fühlt Potter direkt mal auf den Zahn.

Potter scheint seine Qualitäten zu haben. (Senderinfo).

actor.role: Captain Father John Francis Patrick Mulcahy

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc: Erneut wird das Camp von den eigenen Truppen beschossen. Selbst das mehrmalige Intervenieren von Colonel Potter bringt keine Besserung. Auf zu viele Patienten kommen viel zu wenige Mitarbeiter, außerdem herrscht klirrende Kälte. Dazu kommt noch Frank Burns’ miese Stimmung. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: M*A*S*H
programme.desc:
Eher belustigt nimmt Hawkeye zur Kenntnis, dass er von den Militärbürokraten für tot erklärt wurde.

So etwas scheint häufiger vorzukommen, da auch Captain Pierce angeblich gefallen sein soll, der allerdings quicklebendig und ziemlich zornig das zuständige Büro aufsucht.

Plötzlich vergeht allerdings auch Hawkeye der Spaß, denn die Army hat bereits seinen Vater über sein angebliches Ableben informiert. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc: Deacon und Kelly engagieren Spence als ihre Haushaltshilfe. Alles läuft perfekt: Er kocht gut und kümmert sich liebevoll um die Kinder. Doch keiner rechnet mit dem vernachlässigten Danny.\n\nArthur sieht ein gemaltes Bild von Kerbie, auf dem er mit schrecklichen Zähnen abgebildet ist. Daraufhin will er eine Zahnspange haben, doch Doug findet, dass sich das in seinem Alter nicht mehr lohnt. Carrie kann ihrem Vater allerdings nichts abschlagen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: King of Queens
programme.desc:
Kelly und Deacon kaufen sich ein Ferienhaus am See, und Carrie und Doug sind verwundert, wie die beiden sich das leisten können.

Nach vielen Mutmaßungen kommen sie zu dem Schluss, dass sie beide das Haus mitfinanziert haben, weil sie immer die Rechnungen übernehmen, wenn sie mit Kelly und Deacon ausgehen.

Als sie in das Haus eingeladen werden, fühlen sie sich sehr unwohl und versuchen, jeder anstehenden Rechnung aus dem Weg zu gehen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Eddie flippt aus, als seine Schwester Laura ihn bei einem Computerspiel übertrifft. Für Carl Anlass genug, mit seinem Sohn einmal ein Wörtchen zu reden.

Er erklärt seinem Sprössling, dass die Frauen in den 90ern anders zu behandeln seien. Doch dann wird Carl beim Bowling von Harriette geschlagen. Zufall oder nicht?

Der Streit eskaliert, und die gesamte Familie fährt mitten in der Nacht zur Bowlingbahn – zum Entscheidungskampf Frauen gegen Männer. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alle unter einem Dach
programme.desc:
Eddie hat eine Band gegründet. Da sie keinen Übungsraum haben, funktionieren sie kurzerhand das Wohnzimmer der Winslows um – sehr zum Missfallen von Carl.

Die Band dreht ein Rockvideo, um an einem Talentwettbewerb teilnehmen zu können. Weil aber auf dem fertigen Video nur Eddie zu sehen ist, kündigen ihm die anderen die Freundschaft.

Carl kommt auf die Idee, das Video mit der Familie zu machen und am Wettbewerb teilzunehmen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Louis' unheimliche Begegnung mit den Außerirdischen
programme.desc: Sie sind weder klein noch grün, sondern können jede mögliche Gestalt annehmen. Kein Wunder also, dass der Adrenalinspiegel von Wachtmeister Cruchot (Louis de Funès) in schwindelerregende Höhe schnellt. Er ist der Erste, der das Ufo am Strand von St.-Tropez entdeckt und Bekanntschaft mit den Außerirdischen macht. Die haben jede Menge Spaß und klonen zunächst mal Cruchots total vertrottelte Kollegen…\n\nEin Jahr nach dem Welterfolg von Steven Spielbergs „Unheimliche Begegnung der dritten Art“ glaubte Regisseur Jean Girault, die Ufo-Euphorie veralbern zu müssen. So sind sie halt, die Franzosen.

programme.title: Louis und seine verrückten Politessen
programme.desc: Doch zu früh gefreut: Gendarm Cruchot und seine Kollegen sollen weibliche Verstärkung bekommen. Kaum sind die jungen Spürnäschen eingetroffen, verschwinden sie plötzlich ohne jede Spur…\n\nDer sechste Polizeispaß der Serie sollte leider auch der letzte sein: Regisseur Jean Girault starb noch während der Dreharbeiten. Louis de Funès erlag wenig später einer Herzattacke.

programme.desc: Een prominente journaliste (Linda Hamilton) wier man haar net heeft verlaten, interviewt Parijs' meest geheimzinnige en succesvolle bordeelhoudster. Wat ze nooit verwacht, is dat de bordeelhoudster haar koude façade zal afbreken en haar zal helpen zich weer begeerlijk te voelen.

programme.title: Body Of Evidence
programme.desc: Na een nacht van ongebreidelde passie staat Rebecca Carlson (Madonna) terecht voor moord. Nu is het aan haar advocaat (Willem Dafoe) om haar onschuld te bewijzen... maar de weg naar de waarheid blijkt net zoveel bochten te hebben als zijn verleidelijke cliënte.

programme.title: Skybound
programme.desc: Vijf vrienden vliegen met een privéjet van New York naar LA als ze op mysterieuze wijze het radiocontact verliezen. Het lijkt erop dat zich op de grond een grote ramp heeft afgespeeld. Dan ontdekken ze verstekeling Erik aan boord, die hen ook nog eens dwingt in de lucht te blijven.

programme.title: Runner Runner
programme.desc: Richie is ervan overtuigd dat hij is opgelicht tijdens het online pokeren. Hij besluit om naar Costa Rica te reizen om Ivan Block, de eigenaar van de gokwebsite, te confronteren.

programme.title: Kickboxer: Vengeance
programme.desc: Eric Sloane is een Amerikaanse kickboksprof en in zijn zoektocht naar glorie wordt hij geholpen door zijn broer Kurt. Maar wanneer de twee naar Thailand gaan om het op te nemen tegen de legendarische Tong Po, slaat de tegenstander Eric hardhandig neer en laat hem verlamd achter.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland - Canada's Eastern Point
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: NAVIGATING GLOBAL ECONOMIC CHANGE Exclusive with WEF President
programme.desc: The year 2026 marks the 20th anniversary of the establishment of the World Economic Forum's Beijing Representative Office. CGTN's Guan Xin speaks with Alois Zwinggi, president and CEO of WEF, to look back on nearly five decades of cooperation between WEF and China, examine the future of globalization and explore how 'China Opportunity 2.0' can further advance global cooperation in supply chain resilience, green technology and AI governance.

programme.title: Tennis Australia exec on the Australian Open's China push
programme.desc: China is taking center court in the Australian Open's global growth strategy. The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China's east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China's largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess's birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good..

Holloway wordt gedood terwijl hij een gevaarlijk indianenopperhoofd begeleidt naar de gevangenis van een ander fort. Het opperhoofd ontsnapt. Wetende dat hun fort in gevaar is voor een Indiaanse aanval, neemt Lance een kleine groep buitenbeentjes mee naar een verlaten nabijgelegen legerfort om een bergpas te verdedigen tegen de naderende Indiaanse aanval. Hun missie is tijd rekken tot versterkingen uit een ander fort aankomen. De mannen in deze kleine groep van ontevredenen, deserteurs, psychopaten en lafaards haten kapitein Lance en wensen hem dood. programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh gets the show on the road with her Italian- inspired Fennel Orange Salad. Seared sushi-grade tuna rests on top of a crunchy, zesty, tangy fennel and orange salad with a honey-vinegar dressing to sweeten it up! Micah Trainor's revamp? Five Spice Duck a L'Orange with a sugary caramelized orange sauce and duck fat fried potatoes - is it French? Chinese? Who knows, but it's delicious! Next, Poppy Sandler pulls off a vegetarian variation, with a Roasted Veggie Bouillabaisse, complete with musky morels, umami-packed kombu, and tender asparagus. Missy Hui finishes up with her Orange Licorice Panna Cotta - aromatic orange blossom honey and licorice-like fennel pollen make the dish a decadent denouement to this episode of Up the Dish.

programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Heartland

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond

Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: The 2026 season kicks off with an electric atmosphere as the world’s most elite drivers descend upon Brooklyn and Tampa for a showcase of raw power and technical brilliance. Witness the intensity reach a fever pitch during the first "father and son" Racing matchup of the year, where family ties are set aside in the pursuit of the next round. Competitors push their machines past the breaking point in Freestyle, featuring high-stakes maneuvers like the Morgan & Morgan backflip and a spectacular "Maximum moonwalk" performed from never-before-seen angles. With hoods flying and trucks performing impossible cartwheels to save their runs, this episode captures every heart-stopping moment of a lineup coming out "swinging with a ton more energy".

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: The Huntington Center in Toledo ignites with Ohio Octane as Round 11 of the Freestyle Mania Championship Series gets underway. In a high-stakes showdown that blends the raw power of Monster Jam with elite freestyle motocross, eight top-tier teams battle for supremacy on a track described as "sticky like bubble gum". Watch as Weston Anderson in Grave Digger attempts to set a blistering pace against fierce competition from Fernando Martinez in El Toro Loco and hometown hero Chuckie Pauken. From the high-speed precision of JCB Racing to the gravity-defying maneuvers of the Two-Wheel Skills Challenge, every moment is a quest for the critical points needed to crown the night's overall champion.

programme.desc: Experience the heart-pounding intensity of the 2025 season as the world’s most elite drivers push their massive machines to the absolute breaking point. From Todd Leduc battling steering failure to secure a storybook finish to Kayla Blood fighting mechanical "gremlins" in a high-stakes run, the drama never stops on the dirt. Witness gravity-defying technical skills like the "popper maneuver" and the precision "nose flick" , all leading up to a freestyle frenzy packed with breathtaking Morgan & Morgan backflips. This compilation captures the pure adrenaline of Monster Jam, where rivalries are settled and legends like the Anderson family fight to stay at the top of the leaderboard.

Yamato is opgedragen om de negenstaartige chakra te onderdrukken die Naruto's lichaam nadelig zou beïnvloeden. Dan wordt het geheim van Yamato's Hout-Stijl ninjutsu duidelijk.

programme.desc: Gebruikmakend van de verwarring, neemt Sai contact op met Orochimaru. Na de inhoud van de documenten die aan hem zijn gegeven te hebben bekeken, besluit Orochimaru om Sai terug te brengen naar het schuilplaats.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden

programme.desc: Caernarfon - In zijn geboortestad Caernarfon duikt chef Chris "Flamebaster" in de rijke culinaire tradities van Noord-Wales. Ook bezoekt hij een duurzame paddenstoelenboerderij en proeft hij fine dining bij restaurant Sheeps and Leeks. De aflevering eindigt met een visfeest op zijn oude woonwijk, met vers gevangen makreel van lokale vissers.

programme.title: Snel, Makkelijk & Lekker

programme.title: Becoming Meewis

programme.title: Streetfood
programme.desc: Eindhoven.

programme.title: Wild van Wild
programme.desc: Everzwijn - In dit programma gaat njam-chef Jan Buytaert op zoek naar het wild dat in de vrije natuur heeft geleefd en gegeten, wat meteen de essentie van 'echt' wild is. Samen met wildexpert Gert Michiels maakt Jan een tocht doorheen het Vlaamse landschap, om telkens één specifiek dier en zijn habitat te ontdekken en er meer over te weten te komen. Na deze introducerende babbel over het dier, gaat Jan ter plaatse aan de slag om in deze prachtige herfstomgeving een lekker en toegankelijk wildgerecht klaar te maken.

programme.title: Tot op het Bot: Het Rund
programme.desc: Chef Johan Segers staat ervoor bekend om ook de minder bekende delen van een dier met veel liefde te bereiden en vandaag kiest hij dan ook voor de wangen van het rund. Samen met slager Benny Vermeulen overloopt hij de eigenschappen van een rundwang en krijgt hij nog enkele interessante weetjes over dit stuk vlees te horen. Met deze fameuze lappen vlees maakt onze chef een lekkere stoverij en daarbij serveert hij, heel traditioneel maar onovertrefbaar: een oerdegelijke witloofsalade.

programme.title: De Eregast
programme.desc: Gert Verhulst.

programme.title: Vlaanderen kookt
programme.desc: Vlamingen zijn Bourgondiërs. Ze weten dat eten een warm en sociaal gebeuren is.Elk gezin heeft wel een speciaal gerecht waar het trots op is. Een specialiteit die ze maar al te graag delen met vrienden en kennissen. Een recept dat een plaats verdient in een kookboek.

programme.title: Beach Barbecue
programme.desc: Chef Michaël Vrijmoed barbecuet vandaag op het strand. Hij verwent de hongerige surfers en strandgangers met heerlijk gegrild buikspek met een avocadosalade, bruschetta's met mosselen en aubergines, en een sappige lamskroon met gegrilde asperges en zelfgemaakte pesto. Het zijn de ideale ingrediënten voor heerlijk beach food en een relaxte sfeer, in Beach Barbecue.

programme.title: In de Mix
programme.desc: Peppe Giacomazza draait Italiaanse rijstballetjes en Jelle Beeckman serveert 'portie friet chicken ceasar'. Dominique Persoone verstopt vijgen in z'n brood, Jeroen De Pauw bakt muffins in de deli-fryer en Stephanie Bex maakt zoete galette.

programme.title: Bal National
programme.desc: Aflevering 2 - In Bal National laat Wim zien hoe je ook thuis een smeuïg smaakbommetje in een gehaktbal kan verbergen. Hij maakt de basissaus voor de vulling en bereidt twee smakelijke en heel verschillende varianten. Eerst vult hij het gehakt met een smeuïge vulling op basis van prei en Thaise groene curry. Vervolgens stopt hij een vulling met gerookt spek en uien in z'n gehaktballen.

programme.title: KLAAR IN 20 minuten
programme.desc: Vandaag komt in onze keuken zijn zegje doen: De Pauw Jeroen! Hij legt groentjes op de teppanyaki en ook een lekker stuk duurzaam gevangen gele tonijn. Hij overgiet met veel passie en pit, want het sausje is op basis van sriracha.

programme.title: Wild van Wild
programme.desc: Everzwijn - In dit programma gaat njam-chef Jan Buytaert op zoek naar het wild dat in de vrije natuur heeft geleefd en gegeten, wat meteen de essentie van 'echt' wild is. programme.title: Karola's Kitchen
programme.desc: 100% Belgische kost. 100% veggie. 100% comfy en vooral: 100% goed! Dat is wat Karolien vandaag maakt: balletjes in tomatensaus. Ze gebruikt vegan gehakt en veel pompoen en paprika! Die roostert ze en verwerkt ze ook in zacht-zoete hummus.

programme.title: Tot op het Bot: Het Varken
programme.desc: Onze chef Johan Segers kiest vandaag voor één van de populairste zomerproducten van elke beenhouwer: varkensribbekes. Slager Benny legt aan Johan uit welke andere ribben er naast de spare ribs nog bestaan en waarvoor je ze best gebruikt. Daarna beent Benny een paar prachtige ribben uit, en op vraag van onze chef laat hij er genoeg vlees aan zodat Johan er heerlijk van kan peuzelen. Bij de ribbekes serveert de chef een aardappel in de schil met een heerlijke zelfgemaakte kruidenboter.

programme.title: Vietnjam, met Quyên

programme.title: Snel, Makkelijk & Lekker
programme.desc: Vandaag legt Bert Meewis een heerlijk stukje konijn op ons bord. Dat doet hij gezellig op z'n Vlaams. Geen pruim erbij, maar wel met gekaramelliseerde Limburgse appeltjes en een leuke aardappelbereiding. Snel, Makkelijk & Lekker dus.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland - Canada's Eastern Point
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Far out in the "Wild West" of Canada lies Bella Coola. If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons - Spring
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away; a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: NAVIGATING GLOBAL ECONOMIC CHANGE Exclusive with WEF President
programme.desc: The year 2026 marks the 20th anniversary of the establishment of the World Economic Forum's Beijing Representative Office. CGTN's Guan Xin speaks with Alois Zwinggi, president and CEO of WEF, to look back on nearly five decades of cooperation between WEF and China, examine the future of globalization and explore how 'China Opportunity 2.0' can further advance global cooperation in supply chain resilience, green technology and AI governance.

programme.title: Tennis Australia exec on the Australian Open's China push
programme.desc: China is taking center court in the Australian Open's global growth strategy. The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.desc: The Longji Rice Terraces in Guangxi are renowned for their magnificent scenery and unique cultural value. Julian Waghann from the United States and Eliza Arce from the Philippines arrived at the cloud-wrapped Longji Rice Terraces to take part in the most solemn annual farming festival: the Shuyang Festival. From the moment they stepped onto the terraces, they walked along the narrow ridges, joined the ancient seedling-combing ritual, sampled distinctive local cuisine, and lifted torches at nightfall to parade and pray with the villagers through the shimmering paddies. programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China's east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China's largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess's birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good..

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. The Corban Festival began here with the arrival of Islam in the 7th century AD, and has developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar, just as important as Spring Festival. Locals load their tables with food to reward themselves for a year of hard work, and celebrate a tradition of sharing and generosity.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty,..

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh gets the show on the road with her Italian- inspired Fennel Orange Salad. Seared sushi-grade tuna rests on top of a crunchy, zesty, tangy fennel and orange salad with a honey-vinegar dressing to sweeten it up! Micah Trainor's revamp? Five Spice Duck a L'Orange with a sugary caramelized orange sauce and duck fat fried potatoes - is it French? Chinese? Who knows, but it's delicious! Next, Poppy Sandler pulls off a vegetarian variation, with a Roasted Veggie Bouillabaisse, complete with musky morels, umami-packed kombu, and tender asparagus. Missy Hui finishes up with her Orange Licorice Panna Cotta - aromatic orange blossom honey and licorice-like fennel pollen make the dish a decadent denouement to this episode of Up the Dish.

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: The 2026 season kicks off with an electric atmosphere as the world’s most elite drivers descend upon Brooklyn and Tampa for a showcase of raw power and technical brilliance. Witness the intensity reach a fever pitch during the first "father and son" Racing matchup of the year, where family ties are set aside in the pursuit of the next round. Competitors push their machines past the breaking point in Freestyle, featuring high-stakes maneuvers like the Morgan & Morgan backflip and a spectacular "Maximum moonwalk" performed from never-before-seen angles. With hoods flying and trucks performing impossible cartwheels to save their runs, this episode captures every heart-stopping moment of a lineup coming out "swinging with a ton more energy".

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: The Huntington Center in Toledo ignites with Ohio Octane as Round 11 of the Freestyle Mania Championship Series gets underway. In a high-stakes showdown that blends the raw power of Monster Jam with elite freestyle motocross, eight top-tier teams battle for supremacy on a track described as "sticky like bubble gum". Watch as Weston Anderson in Grave Digger attempts to set a blistering pace against fierce competition from Fernando Martinez in El Toro Loco and hometown hero Chuckie Pauken. From the high-speed precision of JCB Racing to the gravity-defying maneuvers of the Two-Wheel Skills Challenge, every moment is a quest for the critical points needed to crown the night's overall champion.

From Todd Leduc battling steering failure to secure a storybook finish to Kayla Blood fighting mechanical "gremlins" in a high-stakes run, the drama never stops on the dirt. Witness gravity-defying technical skills like the "popper maneuver" and the precision "nose flick" , all leading up to a freestyle frenzy packed with breathtaking Morgan & Morgan backflips. This compilation captures the pure adrenaline of Monster Jam, where rivalries are settled and legends like the Anderson family fight to stay at the top of the leaderboard.

programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.
